title: Fix 8 keyboard bugs: numpad 0, bridges, swipe algo, abc toggle, size, space-up, circle, backspace swipe
description: 8 reported bugs in tapezeKeyboard. 1) 0 missing from numpad layer. 2) backspace/space strips not visually meeting via side margins. 3) swipe direction algorithm picks wrong letters. 4) abc command tap does not switch back from numbers to letters. 5) default keyboard height too small. 6) swipe-up-from-space should show symbols layer (currently toggles only overlay). 7) circle/uppercase detection too strict — partial circles missed. 8) horizontal swipe on backspace strip should delete word.
